title: OpenAI’s Codex is now in the ChatGPT mobile app
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is going to let users access Codex, its desktop AI tool that can write code and use apps on your computer, from the ChatGPT app on your phone. Following the surge in popularity for Anthropic's Claude Code, OpenAI has been working quickly to try and catch up, including by cutting back on "side quests," shutting down projects like the Sora video-generation tool , and focusing on growing its enterprise business . summary: OpenAI 将 Codex 桌面 AI 编程工具集成到 ChatGPT 移动应用中，用户可通过手机监控、引导和批准编码任务。此举紧跟 Anthropic Claude Code 的流行趋势，标志着 OpenAI 在移动端扩展 AI 编程能力的重要一步，使开发者能随时随地管理代码生成。

title: Microsoft starts canceling Claude Code licenses
raw_excerpt: Microsoft first started opening up access to Claude Code in December, inviting thousands of its own developers to use Anthropic's AI coding tool daily. It was part of an effort to get project managers, designers, and other employees to experiment with coding for the first time, and sources tell me that Claude Code has proved very popular inside Microsoft over the past six months. Perhaps a little too popular, as Microsoft is now preparing to walk back its Claude Code push. I understand that Microsoft is planning to remove most of its Claude Code licenses and push many of its developers to use Copilot CLI instead. While Claude Code has been  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 微软计划撤销大部分 Claude Code 许可证，转而推动开发者使用内部 AI 工具。此前微软曾向数千名员工开放 Anthropic 的 AI 编码工具，但因使用过于火爆而调整策略。这一转变反映了科技巨头在 AI 工具选择上的战略博弈，以及内部工具与外部产品之间的竞争。

title: AI Chipmaker Cerebras Raises $5.55 Billion in Year's Biggest IPO
raw_excerpt: Cerebras raised $5.5 billion in its US IPO at a market valuation of about $40 billion. This was the largest IPO this year so far. The IPO drew orders for more than 20 times the number of shares available. The offering was led by Morgan Stanley, Citigroup, Barclays, and UBS.
summary: AI 芯片公司 Cerebras 在美 IPO 融资 55 亿美元，市值约 400 亿美元，成为今年最大 IPO。订单超额认购超 20 倍，由摩根士丹利、花旗等投行承销。这标志着 AI 硬件市场的强劲需求，Cerebras 作为英伟达的竞争对手，其上市为 AI 芯片赛道注入新活力。

title: Claude for Small Business
raw_excerpt: Anthropic launched Claude for Small Business, a package of connectors and workflows that embeds Claude into tools like QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365.
summary: Anthropic 推出“Claude for Small Business”套餐，将 Claude 集成到 QuickBooks、PayPal、HubSpot、Google Workspace 和 Microsoft 365 等中小企业常用工具中。此举旨在降低 AI 使用门槛，帮助中小企业通过自动化工作流提升效率，是 AI 向垂直场景渗透的重要案例。

title: Anthropic forms $200M partnership with the Gates Foundation
summary: Anthropic 与盖茨基金会达成 2 亿美元合作，将利用 AI 技术推动全球健康和发展领域的创新。这一合作不仅为 Anthropic 带来资金支持，也标志着 AI 在公益领域的应用获得顶级机构认可，可能加速 AI 在医疗、教育等社会问题上的落地。

title: Granite Embedding Multilingual R2: Open Apache 2.0 Multilingual Embeddings with 32K Context — Best Sub-100M Retrieval Quality
summary: IBM 发布 Granite Embedding Multilingual R2 模型，采用 Apache 2.0 开源协议，支持 32K 上下文窗口，在子 1 亿参数规模的多语言嵌入模型中达到最佳检索质量。该模型为多语言 NLP 应用提供了高效、开放的解决方案，尤其适合资源受限的场景。

title: Cline releases open-source agent runtime SDK for coding agents
raw_excerpt: @cline/sdk is an open-source framework for building agentic applications. It has a plugin architecture that makes it easy to customize, and the framework has all the features expected from agents, like checkpoints, web fetch, MCPs, cron jobs, subagents, and more. The SDK can be used to run agents from CI/CD pipelines, create automations for end-to-end workflows, or embed agents directly inside products.
summary: Cline 发布开源 Agent Runtime SDK (@cline/sdk)，用于构建编码代理应用。该框架支持插件架构、检查点、网络抓取、MCP、定时任务、子代理等功能，可集成到 CI/CD 流水线或产品中。这是 AI 代理开发工具链的重要补充，降低了构建自主代理的门槛。

title: Microsoft's multi-agent AI system tops Anthropic's Mythos on cybersecurity benchmark
raw_excerpt: Microsoft's MDASH AI system uses more than 100 specialized AI agents to work together across multiple AI models to find real-world software vulnerabilities. A set of agents scans code for potential vulnerabilities, and then a separate group of agents debates whether each finding is real and exploitable. A final stage constructs proof-of-concept attacks to confirm the bugs exist. MDASH surpassed Anthropic's Mythos model on the CyberGym benchmark, a test that measures how well AI systems can reproduce real-world vulnerabilities.
summary: 微软的多代理 AI 系统 MDASH 在网络安全基准测试中超越 Anthropic 的 Mythos。MDASH 使用 100 多个专业代理协同工作，通过代码扫描、辩论验证和概念验证攻击三个阶段发现真实漏洞。这展示了多代理协作在复杂安全任务中的巨大潜力。

title: 腾讯开源 Agent 记忆技术方案，Token 消耗最高降低 61%
summary: 腾讯开源 Agent 记忆技术方案，通过优化记忆管理使 Token 消耗最高降低 61%，任务成功率最高提升 51%。该方案解决了 AI 代理在长对话中的记忆瓶颈问题，对提升 Agent 的实用性和经济性具有重要意义，为行业提供了可复用的技术参考。

title: MinT: Managed Infrastructure for Training and Serving Millions of LLMs
summary: 论文《MinT: Managed Infrastructure for Training and Serving Millions of LLMs》提出管理数百万大模型训练和推理的基础设施方案。该研究针对大规模 LLM 部署中的资源调度和效率问题，提供了系统化的解决方案，对 AI 基础设施设计具有指导价值。
